info.title: Doc HTTP Endpoint
info.description:
The Doc API bypasses caching, so every request goes to the backend. To fetch content in most cases, use the Query API instead.

Requests to a public dataset don't need a token, but they return only published documents. To read drafts, release versions, or any document in a private dataset, authenticate requests with a token that has read access to those documents. Documents the request can't read aren't returned. Instead, the response lists their IDs in `omitted` with the reason `permission`.

get.description:
Returns the latest version of one or more documents by ID, without the delay of the query index. It is less scalable than the Query API, so use it only when you need the most recent write.

The endpoint accepts only the query parameters listed here. Any other parameter, including `perspective`, returns a `400` error.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of document IDs. IDs aren't validated beyond UTF-8 encoding, so an ID that doesn't match any document is listed in `omitted` with the reason `existence`.

parameters.name: includeAllVersions
parameters.description:
If true, also return the draft and every release version of each published document ID you request. This only applies to published IDs: a draft or version ID returns only that document. Drafts and release versions are returned even if the published document doesn't exist, in which case the published ID is also listed in `omitted` with the reason `existence`.

The parameter can be passed without a value (`?includeAllVersions`), which is the same as `true`.

Requires API version v2025-02-19 or later. Earlier API versions reject the parameter with a `400` error.

parameters.name: excludeContent
parameters.description: If true, return `documents` as `null` and return only `omitted`. Use this to check whether documents exist without fetching their content. The parameter requires a value: `?excludeContent` without one returns a `400` error.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: A tag to identify the request in logs. Can be passed only once.

200.description: Returns a list of matching documents. Document shape matches a Sanity document and includes all non-null fields.

documents.description: The documents the request can read. `null` when `excludeContent` is true.

omitted.description: IDs that weren't returned, with the reason. `existence` means no document has that ID. `permission` means the request can't read the document.

400.description:
Invalid request. Returned for:

- A document ID that isn't valid UTF-8 (`invalid UTF-8 in ID: …`).
- A non-boolean `excludeContent` or `includeAllVersions` value (`invalid excludeContent specified: …`, `invalid includeAllVersions specified: …`).
- An unsupported query parameter (`Unknown query parameter "…"`), including `includeAllVersions` on API versions earlier than v2025-02-19.
- `tag` passed more than once (`tag can only occur once`).
